title: Gunsmith callout screen: a generic weapon silhouette on a pegboard with part callouts (dot, hairline leader, name over kind, L-brackets), title and line top-left
use: A weapon or kit showcase on a site, or the background of an in-game gunsmith. Weapons are generic code-drawn silhouettes.

desc.default: TR-11 使用 7.2 毫米中间威力弹，射速稳定，配件槽位最多。

relations: The weapon is centred at (1150, 560) and fills about 1180 x 520, tilted -4 to -10 degrees.
Each callout: a 4-unit dot on the part, a hairline leader to the label's corner, an 18-unit name over a 14-unit muted kind, L-brackets at the bottom-left and top-right.
decoration: The pegboard, the glow, the weapon silhouette, leaders and brackets: drawn.
